retrievalProfile.description: A low-key studio portrait featuring a subject in dark, gold-trimmed attire against a black void, paired with high-contrast condensed yellow typography in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: low-key studio portrait with black background
condensed sans-serif display type in top left corner
excludeWhen: bright or high-key lighting is required
minimalist modern sans-serif fonts are preferred over vintage condensed styles

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-quarter length studio portrait of a person seated diagonally, emerging from a deep black background. The subject wears dark clothing with ornate gold brocade details on the cuffs and collar. The lighting is directional, highlighting the face and hands while letting the body recede into shadow. A bold, condensed yellow title is positioned in the top left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal body orientation creating dynamic tension
Gold accents on clothing echoing the yellow typography
High-contrast lighting focusing on facial features and skin texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, angled towards the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the gold-trimmed cuff near the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow text in the top left, moves down the diagonal line of the subject's arm to the center, and then up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the left side and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background and clothing providing a void-like canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold embroidery providing organic texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow/gold used for the display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the bright text/highlights; low saturation overall except for the yellow accents.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophe or decorative mark integrated between letters
Last letter may be slightly smaller or superscripted
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for impact; no secondary type.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal underline beneath the final character

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and narrow profile.
Matches the clean, late-80s geometric sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person with curly hair, wearing a black jacket with ornate gold brocade cuffs and collar, seated against a solid black background. Use low-key lighting to highlight the face and hands.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text in the top left corner using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif font in a bright yellow-gold color.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and yellow?
Are the gold embroidery details visible on the clothing?
Is the lighting directional and low-key?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of yellow for the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the gold trim looks like fabric texture, not flat color.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the subject's eyes are a focal point of the lighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key studio portrait + black void + gold textile accents + condensed yellow display type.
